data.title: Bitcoin falls nearly $2,000 in 20 minutes as $400 million in longs get liquidated
data.description: Bitcoin dropped nearly $2,000 in about 20 minutes, and roughly $400 million in leveraged long bets went up in smoke along the way.On October 6, 2026, Bitcoin slid more than 5% intraday.
